summary: Create, delete, set, or apply live ASCET changes with explicit post-write readback confirmation safeguards.
routingHints: All write commands must run through serial live access and follow AscetVerifyTool.readback confirmation.

AscetVerifyTool.readback inherits the routed summary command: object-specific routes (AscetReadClassSummary, AscetReadModuleSummary, AscetReadStateMachineSummary, AscetReadProjectFormulas) are legacy one-shot with hostEligible=false, while the generic fallback via AscetReadComponentSummary inherits pooled_read with hostEligible=true.
Prefer the most specific write command available for the object kind.
Use apply commands for spec-driven restores or synchronization flows, not ad hoc text edits.
